speaker: provider

text.en: Do not take ibuprofen or aspirin when you have a fever. Take paracetamol only.
text.th: ถ้ามีไข้ ห้ามกินไอบูโพรเฟนหรือแอสไพริน กินพาราเซตามอลเท่านั้น

source.note: Written 2026-10-13 from the disease-burden report. English and Thai are unreviewed drafts by the scaffold author.

notes: Dengue deaths in Thailand are linked to NSAID use before diagnosis (DDC weekly report 2025). This record is skipped at build until Burmese or Mon reaches status 'human'.
